correctness.rationale: Reconstructed exact definitions and finite quantifiers for 81 targets and 243 centers. Seven prototype translation-orbits yield 21 distinct centers and a disjoint partition of 27 normalized target orbits (81 original targets). Ten target symmetry orbits are exhaustive and have total nonnegative integer weight 468. The 25 center symmetry-orbit representatives have shadow weights at most 23; direct enumeration of all 243 centers confirms the inequality and distinct-deletion convention. Hence every cover satisfies 468<=23|C| and has at least 21 centers. The standalone standard-library verifier from the new package returned VERIFY_OK; no extrapolation, optimizer trust, or unstated boundary case remains for the claimed finite equality.

value.rationale: This exact equality answers the natural fixed-alphabet, fixed-length single-deletion covering optimization of current synchronization-error literature. The elementary bound ceil(81/5)=17 is strictly weaker; the certificate increases it to 21, matching an especially structured 21-word partition of all 81 descendants. This gives a nontrivial exact covering-duality benchmark, not merely a routine restatement, a relabeling, or an arbitrary unmotivated slice. Limited to the natural finite parameter and no broad unsolved theorem claimed.
